text: Peverell Semiconductors said Monday it has laid off 1,200 staff across its Marrow Bay chip-making and design operations, citing weaker orders and rising costs. The job cuts took effect over the past two weeks, according to a company notice filed with the city council. Most of the reductions were in production and support roles at the firm’s East Quay plant, with smaller cuts in engineering and administration. Mayor Elinor Vass said the city was arranging help for affected workers. “We know this is a severe blow for many families,” Vass said. Peverell, which employs about 4,800 people locally, said it would keep its research office open and continue limited output at the site.
